gaps.title: Egress policy that allows everything (metadata API still open)
gaps.reason: net-metadata-api-open only checks that an Egress-type policy exists, not that it excludes the metadata address
gaps.would_detect_with: evaluate egress rules with netpol.py against 169.254.169.254/32

gaps.title: Namespaced Role that can read Secrets
gaps.reason: rbac-secret-read-broad only inspects ClusterRoles by design
gaps.would_detect_with: extend the rule to Roles and report namespace-scoped blast radius

gaps.title: Plaintext credentials stored in a Secret object
gaps.reason: the scanner does not read Secret contents (least privilege)
gaps.would_detect_with: secret scanning at commit time (gitleaks) or an admission policy

gaps.title: Long-lived ServiceAccount token stored as a Secret
gaps.reason: no rule inspects Secret type or token age
gaps.would_detect_with: list Secrets by type (metadata only) and flag service-account-token

gaps.title: Image with known CVEs (nginx 1.14.0)
gaps.reason: no image/CVE scanner runs in the offline fixture
gaps.would_detect_with: run with --live --grype (Grype on the running image digests)

gaps.title: Image pulled from an untrusted public registry
gaps.reason: no registry allow-list or signature check

gaps.title: CronJob that downloads and runs a script
gaps.reason: no static rule inspects commands; the dedicated rule was removed in the scope reduction

gaps.title: Mutating webhook that fails open and injects a sidecar
gaps.reason: the admission-control rules were removed in the scope reduction
gaps.would_detect_with: restore the admission rules (evidence is still collected)

gaps.title: No ResourceQuota, LimitRange or PodDisruptionBudget
gaps.reason: the scanner now READS these kinds but has no rule on them
